decisions: Snake game built as vanilla HTML/CSS/JS (no bundler/framework)
Long-running dev server must be started detached via start-server.bat (foreground npx serve gets killed by 120s command timeout)
Board is 20×20 grid; canvas made responsive/HiDPI instead of fixed 480×480
Input queue of up to 2 buffered moves prevents reversing into self
High score persisted in localStorage key 'snake_best'
Neon dark theme chosen for UI
Speed curve mimics original Snake: BASE_SPEED 230ms start, -7ms per food, capped at MIN_SPEED 75ms
Sound effects implemented as zero-asset Web Audio synth in sound.js (no audio files)
Eat sound pitch rises with food streak (520Hz × 1.03^streak, capped at 24)
Mute state persisted in localStorage key 'snake_muted'
sound.js must load before game.js in index.html
Convert game to mobile-first design: responsive HiDPI canvas, safe-area insets, on-screen D-pad, pause/mute chips, tap-to-play, no-zoom/no-scroll
Assistant tooling is text-file read/edit + shell only — cannot view images (df.png must be described by user)
game.js forces the start screen at boot to prevent stale GAME OVER display
Project will be pushed to GitHub repo https://github.com/Elomami1976/VEXI-SNAKE
